scope: Offline synthetic campaign tooling and metadata-only studies of caller-held shared immutable snapshots. No Outlook automation, networking, account access, or store mutation.

corpus.addresses: The required dedicated test account must use outlook.com or example.test. All other addresses use example.test.
corpus.fields: The manifest gives every emitted MIME header and the exact decoded body. Subjects have distinct lengths and campaign markers. Nonempty bodies differ between cases. Empty bodies have no searchable encoding.
corpus.draft_and_importance: X-Unsent is 1. Importance and X-Priority cycle low, normal, and high. Read and follow-up flags are unsupported.
corpus.import_limit: The files round-trip as MIME templates in tests. Outlook import, Date preservation, flag handling, and HTML normalization require the orchestrator's TEST-account experiment. No runtime behavior is claimed.

differential.guard: Requires --synthetic-store and an unchanged generated manifest. Every declared marker must occur in a verified after-copy payload. Missing markers, unsupported store headers, and corrupt blocks fail with a fixed error and no stdout.
differential.disclosure: No store bytes, text values, paths, or hex dumps appear in either report stream. Even the Rust locate worker emits only numerical locations and fixed record classifications.
differential.guard_limit: Markers establish campaign presence, not the absence of unrelated mail. Only dedicated TEST-account copies are authorized inputs.
differential.coordinates: file_ranges and block_offset use physical file offsets. payload_ranges, payload_offset, and record bounds use decompressed payload offsets. record_offset includes the ten-byte envelope. object_offset starts after that envelope and is null outside object bodies. All ranges are half-open.
differential.comparison: Byte ranges compare the same positions. Blocks pair by physical offset. Relocated blocks appear as removals and additions. No logical message identity or compressed-to-decompressed byte mapping is inferred.
differential.record_partition: Uses observe's envelope and mail-anchor partition. Malformed record bounds make the entire verified payload unframed. Hits across record boundaries have record_type cross_record.
differential.encodings: Every nonempty header, individual recipient address, and decoded body is sought as UTF-8 and UTF-16LE. Counts, body lengths, and draft flag are sought as unsigned 16-, 32-, and 64-bit integers in both byte orders. Date instants are sought as FILETIME and Unix milliseconds or seconds in both byte orders, including 32-bit Unix seconds.
differential.limits: Each needle reports at most 4096 locations per snapshot, with uncapped before and after occurrence totals. Search includes overlapping matches. Integer coincidences are observations, not decode confirmations. Markers are checked using occurrence totals before output is released.
differential.resources: The worker reads both immutable copies and retains verified decompressed blocks in memory. It does not support live or concurrently modified stores.

hypothesis_file.corpus_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact manifest file bytes

hypothesis_rules.identity: Field IDs name object byte offsets, never wire field IDs. Offset 10 is the first byte after the object class and reserved bytes, or record offset 20.
hypothesis_rules.evidence: Every case ID must exist in the bound corpus. manifest_field names the scalar expected value, such as subject, date, or headers.To. The importer attaches the manifest SHA-256 to each atlas hypothesis. Import replaces hypotheses with the same field ID and emits the entire validated atlas to stdout without modifying inputs. Review the emitted atlas before replacing the source file.
hypothesis_rules.confirmation: A human or research executor sets confirmed after the stated corpus cases establish the meaning, fixed length, encoding, and offset. The importer validates provenance and shape, not the scientific conclusion. Candidate hypotheses earn no coverage.
hypothesis_rules.encodings: utf-8, utf-16le, u16le, u16be, u32le, u32be, u64le, u64be, filetime-le, filetime-be, unix-ms-le, unix-ms-be, unix-s-le, unix-s-be, unix-s-u32le, unix-s-u32be
hypothesis_rules.length: Positive fixed byte length, at most 65536. Numeric widths must match the encoding. UTF-16LE lengths must be even. Variable-length fields require a future decoder rather than an oversized fixed-span claim.
hypothesis_rules.coverage: Rebuild hxprobe after importing into hxstore-atlas.json. observe credits only confirmed spans within framed matching object records. Invalid UTF-8 or UTF-16 and out-of-bounds spans receive no credit. Overlaps count once. Values never reach observe output. No confirmed discoveries ship with this harness.

study_diff.workflow: Keep baseline-000 and each subsequent immutable copy private on Studio. Compare consecutive copies after exactly one TEST-account draft, event, flag, attachment, or reply change. A separately captured unchanged control uses the same command. No corpus, manifest, marker import, --synthetic-store, or field hypotheses are required.
study_diff.inputs: Two caller-designated offline immutable snapshot files, including shared Main Identity copies. --immutable-copies asserts caller custody and immutability; it does not prove them or coordinate Outlook. Device, inode, size, mtime, and ctime must remain unchanged across the worker call. The command never writes inputs or copies them to an artifact.
study_diff.framing: Reuse Rust locate, checked blocks, and observe partition. locate requires a nonempty needle file; a fixed zero-byte needle satisfies that interface. All search hits and match counts are discarded. No mailbox-value decoding or second frame parser is added.

output.interpretation: Fixed candidates_only_no_causal_or_field_mapping_claim label. Shared-store activity cannot establish ownership, causality, message identity, or confirmed field mappings.

counts.file_changed_ranges: Number of position-aligned physical file difference ranges.
counts.file_changed_bytes: Sum of physical difference range lengths, including file headers and unframed file regions.
counts.changed_blocks: Number of changed, added, or removed checked blocks paired by physical offset.
counts.added_blocks: Number of blocks present only after at that physical offset.
counts.removed_blocks: Number of blocks present only before at that physical offset.
counts.payload_changed_ranges: Number of position-aligned decompressed difference ranges across changed blocks.
counts.payload_changed_bytes: Sum of decompressed difference range lengths.
counts.records_before: Number of before partition spans overlapping payload differences.
counts.records_after: Number of after partition spans overlapping payload differences.

output.records_before: Array of {record_type, record_id} for candidate before spans.
output.records_after: Array of {record_type, record_id} for candidate after spans.
output.record_type: Existing structural classification identifier from observe, including unframed. Hex digits within object.class identifiers name types; no byte values or hex dumps are emitted.
output.record_id: Decimal physical identifier block_offset:payload_start:payload_end, with half-open decompressed span bounds. Scoped to the corresponding input snapshot. Not an Outlook message ID, stable logical identity, account ID, or proof of an addition/deletion.

study_diff.control: Identical copies succeed with all counts zero and empty record lists. An unchanged GUI control can still produce background shared-store differences; those remain candidates.
study_diff.limitations: Relocated blocks appear removed/added; shifted records can appear changed by positional comparison. Header-only differences can have no changed records. Unframed spans are candidates, not successfully decoded records. File byte counts and payload byte counts are different coordinate systems.
study_diff.disclosure: Stdout contains only fixed schema/interpretation labels, structural change counts, record-type IDs, and physical record IDs. No content, headers, addresses, paths, hashes, byte values, search results, or difference ranges. No detailed artifact is written. Worker stdout and stderr are captured and never forwarded. Success has empty stderr; rejected study inputs have empty stdout, exit 2, and fixed study harness input rejected stderr (argument parsing retains the existing fixed harness error).
study_diff.resources: The Rust worker reads both snapshots and verified decompressed payloads into memory. Its fixed search can retain at most 4096 hits per snapshot internally; these never reach study output. Existing whole-file comparison and memory limits apply.
study_diff.synthetic_guard: The separate diff command remains unchanged and requires --synthetic-store, the intact 20-case generated manifest, and every after marker. study-diff performs no marker searches or field confirmation.

blocked_products: private Studio Calendar widget, decode first

source_boundary.owner: #2050 cx-build4. Call before snapshot/full decoder export and before any intake side effects. The owner must also preserve its decoder integrity pin.
source_boundary.integration_state: pending_owner_hook; no live enablement and no claim existing intake is protected
source_boundary.failure: IntakeBlocked with fixed reason; absent, malformed, mismatched or incomplete receipts fail closed.

state.custody: Explicit caller-owned private directory; 0700 directories and 0600 atomic JSON. No default live path.
state.attempts: UUIDv5 of version/build and exact source fingerprint. Durable started record before any snapshot effect.
state.snapshot: Existing lib.outlook_intake._snapshot adapter only. One private helper copy per attempt. Never rebuild helper.
state.observation: Existing hxprobe observe command only. Capture streams, reject stderr/nonzero exit, changed copy metadata or changed app/source. No content decoder or second store parser.
state.accepted: Separate accepted.json, replaced only by explicit accept of a complete supported receipt. Attempting a version never acknowledges it.
state.recovery: Revisit terminal receipts without repeating effects. A started receipt becomes blocked with reconciliation required. Never blindly repeat an interrupted helper or observer. Unobserved intermediate app versions remain missed; only the currently installed build is checked.
state.alerts: Private alerts/<stable UUID>.json outbox for orchestrator custody. One durable actionable alert per version/source attempt. One fixed preflight alert for unavailable version/source. Delivery is not claimed until orchestrator acknowledges it. Every alert names the orchestrator as recipient.
state.alert_delivery: Orchestrator must poll and receipt the private outbox after reviewed merge. No report-problem call, new substrate Work Request, network send or automatic retry is implemented.
state.source_receipts: sources/<source fingerprint>.json retains each exact observer/source manifest; accepted baseline provenance is not overwritten by a later attempt.

comparison.baseline: Last explicitly accepted structural map, bound to version/build and source fingerprint.
comparison.projection: Block types, record types and field ID/identifier-kind/wire-type triples. Exclude occurrences, byte totals and coverage percentages from drift decisions.
comparison.interpretation: Candidate differences only. Type presence/absence can vary with normal activity. Counts and presence changes do not prove a format change.
comparison.incomplete: Any issues, issue_counts, unverified/undecodable blocks, invalid totals, unknown types or empty observations block acceptance.
comparison.scope: Structural compatibility cannot establish account ownership or complete mail/calendar semantics.

operational_path.install: After reviewed merge and #2050 source integration, orchestrator provisions an explicit private state directory and reviewed observer SHA-256. No LaunchAgent/config is installed here.
operational_path.review: Inspect private alerts and observation receipts. Research unsupported classes without granting coverage. Do not reattempt an interrupted effect without reconciling its receipt.
operational_path.accept: Use the same arguments with accept only after structural review. Unknown or incomplete observations cannot be accepted.
operational_path.gate: Use the same arguments with gate to verify acceptance; #2050 must call the Python source boundary inside the intake process, not rely on this external command.
operational_path.scheduler: Orchestrator may design/install scheduling separately after reviewed source merge; this desk does not enable jobs.
operational_path.exit_codes: check exits 3 until acceptance, including complete observations awaiting review. Accepted check/gate/accept exit 0. Rejected input or failed operation exits 2 with fixed stderr.

limitations: No real Outlook bundle/store, installed helper or decoder was inspected or run in this desk.
No full mapping, live account safety, runtime hook integration, alert delivery or scheduler installation is claimed.
Versions with novel or unresolved classes remain blocked until source evidence and the atlas are reviewed.
Crash recovery refuses ambiguous operations; reconciliation is an operator task, not an automatic new snapshot.
Reviewed observer binary/source correspondence must be established by the release owner; hashing the binary binds bytes but does not prove how it was built.
